summary: iPhone: close the last tab and keep zero tabs
manual: With pins and kept tabs, close the last today's tab: empty page, + New Tab on the plate, no pin in front. Tap the plate: New Tab field.
One today's tab: the right button is +. Hold it: New Tab, New Private Tab, All Tabs. Swipe the one card away: empty page with Undo; Undo brings the tab back.
Fresh install, finish the welcome: zero tabs, New Tab field and keyboard. Cancel: empty page.
Paired with a Mac: zero tabs on the iPhone leaves the Mac's pins and kept in place, closed tabs do not return, a tab opened on the Mac waits in the stack without coming in front.
